name: Functional replacement and route equivalence
description: Represent whether an alternative replaces the same reaction, one reference activity, a different route to the same product or demand for the missing function.
claim_scope: A reference-function/route relationship with restored outcome, unfilled activities and changed resource demands explicit.
distinctions: One activity versus whole multifunctional reference.
One-condition rescue versus complete native interchangeability.
Equivalent product versus changed recycling/donor demands.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: Rescue does not establish the same reaction/all reference activities.
No annotated known-family enzyme does not establish absent function.
Bookkeeping equivalence depends on stated boundaries/donor assumptions.
Heterologous substitution does not establish primary native role.
boundary: A09 asks whether an alternative makes a target dispensable; A10 asks what contribution it provides; A04 gives the resulting requirements. This is a relation to annotate, not a prescribed comparison procedure.

evidence.source_locator: Figs. 3–9; native deletion/C115S, reconstitution/MS and CaiB Results.
evidence.observation: BioZ bypasses BioC plus BioH using a glutaryl-CoA/malonyl-ACP entry route, restoring precursor output without BioH chemistry.
CobY supplies guanylyltransferase but not detected kinase; de novo rescue does not replace the CobU salvage kinase demand.
ThyA alone incompletely replaces ThyX; adding FolA exposes the folate-recycling demand despite shared dTMP output.
evidence.limit: No specific native backup reductase identified; authors’ simulations not rerun.

evidence.source_locator: Evolution of D27G; Figures 4–6; ThyA/DeoB re-expression contrasts.
evidence.observation: Some evolved lineages partly restore catalysis; others lose thyA/deoB and retain supplementation, separating repair and salvage compensation.
evidence.limit: No evolution/sequencing/omics reanalysis; suppressors do not remove every external requirement.

evidence.source_locator: HemJ not fully replaceable and in-vitro assay subsections.
evidence.observation: HemG supports HemJ substitution in glucose growth but not photoautotrophy, bounding native interchangeability.
evidence.limit: Isolated productive HemJ catalysis and proposed coupling remain unresolved.
